description: Match a LIST of ASINs and/or retail barcodes (UPC / EAN / GTIN / ISBN) to Amazon in one call - e.g. a supplier price list or invoice - and return one row per item: ASIN, title, brand, current price, buy-box seller and fulfillment, whether Amazon sells it, seller count, BSR and category, rating, bought-past-month badge, how the barcode was resolved, and when it was observed. Unknown barcodes are searched on Amazon itself. Use for wholesale / online-arbitrage list screening before deeper checks with asin_profit_calc, evaluate_asin_sourcing or live_offers. Up to 25-200 items per call depending on plan. Amazon marketplaces only.

items.description: ASINs and/or barcodes (a comma-separated string is accepted too).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

name: bulk_product_lookup
